title: Route-aware rerank observability: per-route metrics, cost slices, and trace sampling
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Goal: provide low-overhead, route-aware observability for the embeddings + rerank endpoint so PMs, SREs, and customer-facing engineers can diagnose quality regressions, latency spikes, and unexpected cost increases per route. This ticket covers metrics surface, sampling policy for traces, cost slicing by token/kernel/batch, and alerting rules focused on production rerank traffic. Deliverables: per-route dashboard templates, trace spans and attributes for the reranker stages, cost attribution hooks, and a doc with recommended SLO thresholds and runbook links.
acceptance_criteria: Per-route dashboard card exists showing: 99th/95th/median latency for embed+score, batch size distribution, request QPS, error rate, and KV cache hit rate
Span instrumentation added to rerank pipeline with attributes: route_id, model_variant, batch_size, tokens_generated, kv_cache_hit, vectorize_time_ms, score_time_ms
Cost attribution recorded per-request with breakdown: model_inference_ms, kernel_ms (quantized vs full), and estimated token cost; aggregated as per-route daily and hourly slices
Trace sampling policy implemented: deterministic sampling for failed requests, tail-sampling for high-latency outliers, and reservoir sampling to capture 1 in N normal requests

Alerting rules created for: route-level P99 latency regression (>20% over baseline), sudden increase in cost-per-request (>30% 24h delta), and drop in rerank-quality signal from eval set (see linked eval dashboard)
Dashboard includes links to example traces and a playbook with triage steps and fallback actions (model fallback, reduce batch, pin variant)
implementation_notes: Export new Prometheus metrics with route label: rerank_vectorize_ms_bucket, rerank_score_ms_bucket, rerank_kv_cache_hits_total, rerank_batch_size_histogram
Emit a lightweight structured log (json) per request with minimal fields for offline cost attribution (request_id, route_id, model, tokens, kernel_type, cost_estimate_cents)
Add new trace spans around: embedding_lookup -> kv_cache_check -> batch_assemble -> model_infer -> score_aggregation; include events for fallback invocations
Batch-awareness: when computing latency histograms and cost slices, attribute per-request cost by dividing batch kernel_ms proportionally to tokens or KV hits as defined in cost model doc
Backfill: populate per-route daily cost for last 30 days using sampled logs to validate dashboards before enabling alerting
Performance budget: additional telemetry must add <2% latency overhead on p50 and <5% overhead on p99 in synthetic load tests
